note: Shared work-level glossary for the Odyssey (Murray 1919). Keys are lowercased surface wordforms as printed (an elided form without its apostrophe). One general gloss per form, never pinned to a line; sentence notes carry context.

glossary.αἰγίσθοιο: Αἴγισθος — Aegisthus, seducer of Clytemnestra and killer of Agamemnon, later killed by Orestes; gen. sg.
glossary.αἰθίοπας: Αἰθίοψ — an Ethiopian, one of a people living at the world’s edge; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.αἰπὺν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰτιόωνται: αἰτιάομαι — blame, accuse; pres. 3 pl. mid., epic diectasis (= Attic αἰτιῶνται)
glossary.αἱμυλίοισι: αἱμύλιος — wheedling, cajoling; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.αἴγισθος: Αἴγισθος — Aegisthus, seducer of Clytemnestra and killer of Agamemnon, later killed by Orestes; nom. sg.
glossary.αἴης: αἶα — land, earth; gen. sg., epic by-form of γαῖα
glossary.αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’
glossary.αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
glossary.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said)
glossary.βουλήν: βουλή — plan, counsel, decision; acc. sg.
glossary.βοῦς: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; acc. pl.
glossary.γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
glossary.γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
glossary.γαιήοχος: γαιήοχος — epithet of Poseidon: ’earth-holder’ (or ’earth-carrier’; the derivation is disputed); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
glossary.γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γλαφυροῖσι: γλαφυρός — hollow; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.γῆμ: γαμέω — marry; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (γῆμ’ = ἔγημε)
glossary.δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
glossary.δαΐφρονι: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δαίεται: δαίω — divide, rend · or the distinct verb δαίω — kindle, burn; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: of the heart, ’is torn’ or ’burns’
glossary.δεδαίαται: δαίω — divide; perf. 3 pl. mp., epic -αται (= Attic -νται): ’are divided’
glossary.δενδρήεσσα: δενδρήεις — wooded, full of trees; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δηθὰ: δηθά — for a long time, long; adv.
glossary.διάκτορον: διάκτορος — epithet of Hermes, meaning unknown, traditionally ’guide, messenger’; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.διός: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; gen. sg. (stem Δι-)
glossary.δυσμόρῳ: δύσμορος — ill-fated, unlucky; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δυσομένου: δύω/δύνω — sink, set (of the sun); pres. part. gen. sg.: ’setting’
glossary.δόμονδε: δόμος — house; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to, towards’: ’homeward’
glossary.δύστηνον: δύστηνος — wretched, unhappy; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
glossary.δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
glossary.δῖα: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses and heroes
glossary.εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’
glossary.εἰδὼς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing’
glossary.εἰλίποδας: εἰλίπους — rolling-gaited, swaying-footed (of cattle); masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.εἰπὲ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’)
glossary.εἴπομεν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. 1 pl.: ’we told’
glossary.εἴπῃ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’he may tell’
glossary.εὐρείῃ: εὐρύς — broad, wide; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ)
glossary.εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
glossary.ζηνὸς: Ζεύς — Zeus; gen. sg., alternate stem Ζην- (beside Δι-)
glossary.θέλγει: θέλγω — enchant, bewitch, beguile; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.θανέειν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic θανεῖν)
glossary.θεάων: θεά — goddess; gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῶν)
glossary.θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θείω: τίθημι — put, place; aor. subj. 1 sg. (Attic θῶ)
glossary.θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
glossary.θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
glossary.θόωσα: Θόωσα — Thoösa, a sea-nymph, daughter of Phorcys and mother of Polyphemus by Poseidon; nom. sg.
glossary.κάκ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. (elided κάκ’): ’evils, misfortunes’
glossary.κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’
glossary.καλέσαντα: καλέω — call, summon; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having called’
glossary.καλυψὼ: Καλυψώ — Calypso, the nymph who keeps Odysseus on her island, her name built on καλύπτω ’hide, conceal’; nom. sg.
glossary.κατακτείνει: κατακτείνω — kill outright, slay; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κατερύκει: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’)
glossary.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
glossary.κεχρημένον: χράομαι — use; perf. part. (+ gen.) ’in need of, lacking’; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κεχόλωται: χολόομαι — be angry, be enraged; perf. 3 sg. (state): ’is angry’
glossary.κεῖνός: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead)
glossary.κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown, report; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), direct object: μέγα κλέος ἤρατο ’won great fame’; κλέος φέρειν ’bring report’
glossary.κομόωντας: κομάω — wear one’s hair long; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic diectasis (= Attic κομῶντας)
glossary.κράτος: κράτος — strength, power, might; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.κρειόντων: κρείων — ruling, lord; masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’among those who rule’
glossary.κρονίδη: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus, patronymic/epithet of Zeus; voc. sg.
glossary.κυκλώπεσσι: Κύκλωψ — a Cyclops, one of a race of one-eyed giants; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.κύκλωπος: Κύκλωψ — a Cyclops, one of a race of one-eyed giants; Polyphemus, son of Poseidon, is the one Odysseus blinded; gen. sg.
glossary.λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
glossary.λαθοίμην: λανθάνω — mid. λανθάνομαι forget (+ gen.); aor. opt. 1 sg.: ’I could forget’
glossary.λιλαιομένη: λιλαίομαι — long for, yearn (+ inf.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λόγοισιν: λόγος — word, speech, story (rare in Homer, whose usual words are μῦθος, ἔπος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
glossary.μέγιστον: μέγας — great; superl. neut. nom. sg.: ’greatest’
glossary.μέδοντος: μέδω — rule, be lord of (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. gen. sg.: ’ruling, lord of’
glossary.μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, drive; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.μήτε: μήτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
glossary.μακάρεσσι: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (epithet of the gods); masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
glossary.μακράς: μακρός — long, tall; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.μαλακοῖσι: μαλακός — soft, gentle; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
glossary.μεθήσει: μεθίημι — let go, relax, release; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.μενέαινεν: μενεαίνω — rage, be furious (built on μένος); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.μετεκίαθε: μετακιάθω — go to, visit, go after; aor. 3 sg. (can carry pluperfect force: ’had gone to visit’)
glossary.μετηύδα: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’)
glossary.μιγεῖσα: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; mid./pass. ’unite with’ (+ dat.), the standard expression for sexual union; aor. pass. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
glossary.μνάασθαι: μνάομαι — woo, court; pres. inf., epic diectasis (= Attic μνᾶσθαι)
glossary.μνήσατο: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, call to mind (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented
glossary.μνηστήν: μνηστή — wooed and lawfully wedded; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μνηστήρεσσιν: μνηστήρ — suitor; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
glossary.μοῦσα: Μοῦσα — Muse, goddess of poetic inspiration; voc. sg.
glossary.μόρον: μόρος — portion, fate, allotted share; acc. sg.
glossary.μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
glossary.μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ
glossary.μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
glossary.μῆλ: μῆλον — sheep or goat, flock-animal; neut. acc. pl. (elided μῆλ’)
glossary.νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
glossary.νέηται: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.νήπιοι: νήπιος — childish, foolish, witless; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
glossary.νημερτέα: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted
glossary.νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νοστήσαντα: νοστέω — return home; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having returned’
glossary.νοῆσαι: νοέω — perceive, notice, take note of; aor. inf.: ’to glimpse, to notice’
glossary.νυ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
glossary.νόστιμον: νόστιμος — of homecoming, of return; neut. acc. sg., in νόστιμον ἦμαρ ’day of return’
glossary.νόσφι: νόσφι — apart from, except (+ gen.); adv./prep.
glossary.νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
glossary.νύμφη: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; nom. sg.
glossary.νύμφῃ: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; dat. sg.
glossary.οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’)
glossary.οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.οἴκοι: οἴκοι — at home; adv. (locative of οἶκος)
glossary.οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.οἵδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’these here’
glossary.οἶδεν: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 sg. (with pres. sense): ’knows’
glossary.οἶκόνδε: οἶκος — house, home; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’homeward’
glossary.οἶον: οἶος — alone, only; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; neut. as exclamatory adv.: ’how!, what a thing!’ (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’)
glossary.οἷσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — his own, her own; possessive adj. (distinct from the relative ὅς); masc. dat. pl.: ’his own’
glossary.οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
glossary.οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
glossary.οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
glossary.πάθεν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπαθεν)
glossary.πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl. (elided πάντ’): ’everything’
glossary.πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν
glossary.πάσης: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πέμψαντες: πέμπω — send; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having sent’
glossary.πήματα: πῆμα — suffering, woe, calamity; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.παρήμενος: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit near (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
glossary.πατρίδος: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; gen. sg.
glossary.περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’
glossary.περιπλομένων: περιπέλομαι — revolve, come round; aor. part. gen. pl.: ’as they revolve, rolling round’ (of the years)
glossary.περιφραζώμεθα: περιφράζομαι — consider from every side, devise; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us devise’
glossary.περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’)
glossary.πευσόμενον: πυνθάνομαι — inquire, learn by asking; fut. part. masc. acc. sg., expressing purpose: ’to inquire’
glossary.πεφευγότες: φεύγω — flee, escape; perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having escaped (and remaining safe)’
glossary.πεφυγμένος: φεύγω — flee, escape; perf. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’escaped, clear of’
glossary.πεῖθ: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (πεῖθ’ = πεῖθε)
glossary.πλάγχθη: πλάζω — drive off course, make wander; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was driven astray’
glossary.πλάζει: πλάζω — drive off course, make wander; pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’
glossary.πολύτροπον: πολύτροπος — of many turns, much-turning (much-travelled, or versatile and wily; both senses debated); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πολύφημον: Πολύφημος — Polyphemus, the Cyclops blinded by Odysseus, son of Poseidon; acc. sg.
glossary.πολύφρονα: πολύφρων — of many counsels, much-minded; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ποσειδάων: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon, god of the sea, enemy of Odysseus after the blinding of his son Polyphemus; nom. sg., epic uncontracted
glossary.ποσειδάωνι: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; dat. sg., epic uncontracted
glossary.ποσειδάωνος: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; gen. sg., epic uncontracted (Attic Ποσειδῶνος)
glossary.ποῖόν: ποῖος — what sort of, what kind of; neut. acc. sg., reproachful: ’what a...’
glossary.προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.πρό: πρό — before, beforehand; adv./prep.; also a preverb in tmesis (πρό … εἴπομεν = προείπομεν ’we told beforehand’)
glossary.πτολίεθρον: πτολίεθρον — citadel, city; neut. acc. sg., epic lengthened by-form of πόλις
glossary.πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
glossary.πόποι: πόποι — (in ὢ πόποι) exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! well!’; origin unknown
glossary.πόσιν: πόσις — husband; acc. sg. · also the distinct noun πόσις ’a drinking, drink’ (from πίνω); acc. sg.: ’drink’ (paired with βρῶσις ’eating’)
glossary.πότνι: πότνια — lady, mistress; title of respect for goddesses; fem. nom. sg. (elided πότνι’)
glossary.πύλον: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; acc. sg.
glossary.πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
glossary.σπάρτην: Σπάρτη — Sparta, city in the Peloponnese, home of Menelaus; acc. sg.
glossary.σπέσσι: σπέος — cave; neut. dat. pl. (plural for a single cave), epic -εσσι
glossary.σφάζουσι: σφάζω — slaughter, slay (esp. for sacrifice); pres. 3 pl.
glossary.σφετέρῃσιν: σφέτερος — their own; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.σφῇσιν: σφός — their own; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’
glossary.τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
glossary.τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε)
glossary.τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
glossary.τέκνον: τέκνον — child; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form)
glossary.τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι)
glossary.τίσις: τίσις — payment, vengeance, requital; nom. sg.
glossary.ταλασίφρονος: ταλασίφρων — enduring-minded, steadfast; gen. sg. (epithet of Odysseus, from τλῆναι ’endure’)
glossary.τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
glossary.τηλόθ: τηλόθι (elided τηλόθ’) — far off, at a distance; adverb of place, epic (-θι suffix ’place where’)
glossary.τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’
glossary.τοιαῦτά: τοιοῦτος — such, of this kind; neut. acc. pl. ’such things’
glossary.τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’
glossary.τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
glossary.τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
glossary.τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’
glossary.τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.τροίης: Τροία — Troy; gen. sg. (Ionic -ης for Attic -ας)
glossary.τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg.: ’him’; also relative: ’whom’
glossary.τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially
glossary.τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’
glossary.τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’
glossary.τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’

glossary.τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
glossary.τοιγὰρ: τοιγάρ — well then, accordingly; particle introducing a response to a request
glossary.τοκῆες: τοκεύς — parent, begetter (from τίκτω); nom. pl.
glossary.τούτοισιν: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν: ’to these men’
glossary.τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’)
glossary.τοῖσίν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.; also relative: ’with whom’ (accented τοῖσίν before the enclitic τε)
glossary.τοῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. sg., elided (τοῦτ’ = τοῦτο)
glossary.τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.τόσος: τόσος — so great, so big; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’)
glossary.φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’used to bear’
glossary.φέρουσα: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’carrying, bringing’
glossary.φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
glossary.φίλ: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg., elided (φίλ’ = φίλε)
glossary.φίλης: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φημίῳ: Φήμιος — Phemius, the singer in Odysseus’ house; dat. sg.
glossary.φιλήσεαι: φιλέω — treat as a φίλος, i.e. give a guest what a guest is owed (not only ’love’); fut. 2 sg. mid./pass., uncontracted (= Attic φιλήσῃ)
glossary.φιληρέτμοισιν: φιλήρετμος — oar-loving, fond of the oar (φίλος + ἐρετμόν); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.φορμίζων: φορμίζω — play the lyre (from φόρμιγξ); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φράσσεται: φράζομαι — consider, devise; fut. 3 sg. mid., double σ metrical
glossary.φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
glossary.φῇσιν: φημί — say, assert; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -σι(ν): ’says, may say’
glossary.χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; masc./neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν)
glossary.χέρνιβα: χέρνιψ — water for washing the hands (χείρ + νίζω); acc. sg.
glossary.χαλεποὶ: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, hard to deal with; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χαριζομένη: χαρίζομαι — do a favour, be free with, give freely of (+ gen.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χαῖρε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 sg., the ordinary greeting: ’welcome, hail’
glossary.χεῖρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
glossary.χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.χρή: χρή — there is need (of); impersonal verb, + acc. of person and gen. of thing
glossary.χρυσείῃ: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῇ)
glossary.χρυσοῖό: χρυσός — gold; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic χρυσοῦ), accented on the ultima before the enclitic τε
glossary.χρύσεια: χρύσεος — golden; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ)
glossary.ἀέκοντα: ἄκων — unwilling; masc. acc. sg., epic ἀέκων (= Attic ἄκοντα): ’against his will’
glossary.ἀίξασα: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush, spring; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγήνορας: ἀγήνωρ — very manly, overbearing, lordly (rendered ’lordly’ throughout); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀγήνορες: ἀγήνωρ — very manly, overbearing, lordly (rendered ’lordly’ throughout); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀγορεύσω: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀγροῦ: ἀγρός — field, countryside; gen. sg. (ἐπ’ ἀγροῦ ’out in the country’)
glossary.ἀγχιάλοιο: Ἀγχίαλος — Anchialus, father of Mentes, ’near the sea’; gen. sg., epic -οιο
glossary.ἀγόρευσον: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
glossary.ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
glossary.ἀθήνην: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκαχμένον: ἀκαχμένος — sharpened, of obscure formation; perf. pass. part. masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.ἀλλήλων: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., gen. pl.
glossary.ἀλλοθρόους: ἀλλόθροος — of foreign speech, speaking another tongue (ἄλλος + θρόος); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀλλότριον: ἀλλότριος — belonging to another, another’s; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλωῆς: ἀλωή — orchard, vineyard plot; gen. sg.
glossary.ἀμβρόσια: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine, ambrosial; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμφίπολος: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, woman in attendance; nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιπόλῳ: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, woman in attendance; dat. sg.
glossary.ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
glossary.ἀνάσσοι: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνάσσω: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)
glossary.ἀνέρος: ἀνήρ — man; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνδρός)
glossary.ἀναβήμεναι: ἀναβαίνω — go up (from the coast inland); aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἀναβῆναι)
glossary.ἀναθήματα: ἀνάθημα — ornament, crowning glory (from ἀνατίθημι ’set up, add’; not yet ’votive offering’); neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀνεβάλλετο: ἀναβάλλω — mid. strike up (a song); impf. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἀνθρώπους: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; acc. pl.
glossary.ἀνιηθεὶς: ἀνιάω — distress, vex; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, distressed’
glossary.ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc.
glossary.ἀπείρονα: ἀπείρων — boundless, endless; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀποιχομένοιο: ἀποίχομαι — be gone away, be departed; pres. part. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀπόλωλε: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid./pass. perish; perf. 3 sg.: ’has perished and is gone’
glossary.ἀργυρέοιο: ἀργύρεος — of silver; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -οιο (= Attic ἀργυροῦ)
glossary.ἀρησαίατ: ἀράομαι — pray, vow; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -ατο, elided (ἀρησαίατ’ = ἀρησαίατο): ’they would pray’
glossary.ἀρχῆς: ἀρχή — beginning; gen. sg. (ἐξ ἀρχῆς ’from the start’)
glossary.ἀτρεκέως: ἀτρεκής — exact, unswerving; adv. ἀτρεκέως: ’exactly, precisely’
glossary.ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
glossary.ἀφίκεο: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, come to; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀφίκου)
glossary.ἀφνειότεροι: ἀφνειός — rich, wealthy; comparative masc. nom. pl., + gen. of what one is rich in
glossary.ἁδήσειεν: ἁδέω — have had enough of, take no pleasure in; aor. opt. 3 sg., negative purpose after μή
glossary.ἁλὶ: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg.
glossary.ἄγριοι: ἄγριος — savage, wild; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄγω: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἄγων: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’leading’
glossary.ἄλκιμον: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, staunch (from ἀλκή); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἄμμι: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; epic dat. pl. ἄμμι (= Attic ἡμῖν)
glossary.ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential)
glossary.ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
glossary.ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
glossary.ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows)
glossary.ἐδήσατο: δέω — bind; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’bound on (for herself)’
glossary.ἐκεῖνος: ἐκεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron. (full form, beside the shortened epic κεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐλαφρότεροι: ἐλαφρός — light, nimble; comparative masc. nom. pl., + acc. of respect
glossary.ἐλεύσεσθαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; fut. inf. mid.
glossary.ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
glossary.ἐμισγόμεθ: μίσγω — mix, mingle; mid. meet, associate with (+ dat.); impf. 1 pl. mid., elided (ἐμισγόμεθ’ = ἐμισγόμεθα)
glossary.ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
glossary.ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen.
glossary.ἐπίστροφος: ἐπίστροφος — much-visiting, going about among (+ gen.); nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπελθὼν: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, come upon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone to’
glossary.ἐπεστέψαντο: ἐπιστέφω — crown, fill to the brim (from στέφω); aor. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἐπιδήμιον: ἐπιδήμιος — in one’s own land, at home (ἐπί + δῆμος); masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπιθεῖσα: ἐπιτίθημι — lay on, add; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having laid on’
glossary.ἐπιχθονίων: ἐπιχθόνιος — upon the earth (epithet of mortals, as against the gods); masc./fem. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’)
glossary.ἐπῴχετο: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro to, come round to; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐρυκανόωσ: ἐρυκανάω — hold back, keep back (by-form of ἐρύκω); pres. 3 pl., epic diectasis, elided
glossary.ἐσθῆτός: ἐσθής — clothing, raiment; gen. sg. (accented on the ultima before the enclitic τε)
glossary.ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
glossary.ἐτάνυσσε: τανύω — stretch, draw out; aor. 3 sg., double σ metrical
glossary.ἐτήτυμον: ἐτήτυμος — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
glossary.ἐυξόου: ἐΰξοος — well-planed, well-polished (ἐϋ- + ξέω); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + acc.
glossary.ἐφεστάμεν: ἐφίστημι — stand at, be set over; perf. inf., epic -μεν (= Attic ἐφεστάναι)
glossary.ἐὺ: ἐΰ — well (Attic εὖ, printed without a diaeresis); adv.
glossary.ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
glossary.ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
glossary.ἑρπύζοντ: ἑρπύζω — creep, crawl; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἑρπύζοντ’ = ἑρπύζοντα)
glossary.ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.ἑτοῖμα: ἕτοιμος — ready, at hand; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔβαν: βαίνω — go, walk; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔβησαν)
glossary.ἔγχε: ἔγχος — spear; neut. nom. pl., elided uncontracted (ἔγχε’ = ἔγχεα)
glossary.ἔδουσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι)
glossary.ἔκτοθεν: ἔκτοθεν — outside, away from (+ gen.); adv./prep.
glossary.ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
glossary.ἔοικας: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you are like’
glossary.ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
glossary.ἔροιτο: ἔρομαι — ask; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., purpose after ἵνα: ’might ask’
glossary.ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); acc. sg.
glossary.ἔρχεσθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. inf., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθαι)
glossary.ἔστησε: ἵστημι — set, set up, station; aor. 3 sg. transitive: ’set (it) up’
glossary.ἔτερπον: τέρπω — delight, cheer; impf. 3 pl.: ’were delighting (their heart)’
glossary.ἔφαντ: φημί — say, assert; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided (ἔφαντ’ = ἔφαντο): ’they were saying’
glossary.ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε)
glossary.ἔχευαν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 pl., epic -αν (= Attic ἔχεαν)
glossary.ἔχοι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ἕζοντο: ἕζομαι — seat oneself, sit down; impf. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
glossary.ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ: ’they put away (desire)’
glossary.ἕστηκεν: ἵστημι — set, stand; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’stands, lies at anchor’
glossary.ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
glossary.ἠπείρου: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; gen. sg.
glossary.ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
glossary.ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’
glossary.ἡγεῖθ: ἡγέομαι — lead, lead the way; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἡγεῖθ’ = ἡγεῖτο, aspirated before ἡ)
glossary.ἡμέτερον: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἤγαγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 pl., reduplicated
glossary.ἤειδε: ἀείδω — sing; impf. 3 sg., augment shown as η-
glossary.ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἥδ: ἥδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron. (fem. of ὅδε), fem. nom. sg., elided (ἥδ’ = ἥδε)
glossary.ἥμενοι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’
glossary.ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I have come’
glossary.ἰδοίατο: ὁράω — see; aor. opt. 3 pl., epic -ατο (Attic ἴδοιντο), from the root of εἶδον
glossary.ἰθάκηνδε: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to’: ’to Ithaca’
glossary.ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; prep. + gen. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight towards’
glossary.ἴαλλον: ἰάλλω — send forth, put out (the hand); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε)
glossary.ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον)
glossary.ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’used to go, come’
glossary.ἵστατο: ἵστημι — set, stand; impf. 3 sg. mid./intrans. (neut. pl. subject with sg. verb): ’were standing’
glossary.ὀίομαι: ὀΐομαι — suppose, think, imagine; pres. 1 sg., uncontracted
glossary.ὀίω: ὀΐω — suppose, think (short-form by-word of ὀΐομαι); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ὀβριμοπάτρη: ὀβριμοπάτρη — epithet of Athena alone: ’of the mighty father’ (ὄβριμος + πατήρ); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀνείαθ: ὄνειαρ — good thing, benefit; of food, neut. acc. pl., elided (ὀνείαθ’ = ὀνείατα)
glossary.ὀξέι: ὀξύς — sharp; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
glossary.ὀρυμαγδῷ: ὀρυμαγδός — din, uproar, loud confused noise; dat. sg.
glossary.ὀσσόμενος: ὄσσομαι — see before one, picture to oneself, foresee; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
glossary.ὀτρηροὶ: ὀτρηρός — quick, brisk, busy (of the family of ὀτρύνω); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὁπποίης: ὁποῖος — of what sort; interrog./indef. adj. used directly, fem. gen. sg., double π epic (Ionic η for Attic α)
glossary.ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’)
glossary.ὅττεό: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic gen. sg. neut. ὅττεο (= Attic οὗτινος), governed by χρή
glossary.ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι)
glossary.ὑγρὴν: ὑγρός — wet, moist; fem. acc. sg. used substantively: ’the wet (sea)’
glossary.ὑλήεντι: ὑλήεις — wooded (from ὕλη); masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ὑπερφιάλοισι: ὑπερφίαλος — overbearing, arrogant; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’
glossary.ὑψηλοῖο: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὤλετο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’has perished, is gone’
glossary.ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
glossary.ῥείθρῳ: Ῥεῖθρον — Rheithron, ’stream’, a harbour in Ithaca; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ῥινοῖσι: ῥινός — hide, skin; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
glossary.αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
glossary.αἴγισθον: Αἴγισθος — Aegisthus, seducer of Clytemnestra and killer of Agamemnon, later killed by Orestes; acc. sg.
glossary.αἴσχεα: αἶσχος — disgrace, shame, shameful thing; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic αἴσχη)
glossary.αὐτόν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’himself’, or reinforcing a pronoun of any person (με … καὶ αὐτόν ’me myself as well’)
glossary.αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’)
glossary.αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
glossary.αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
glossary.γένετο: γίγνομαι — become, be born, happen; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγένετο)
glossary.γαμέεσθαι: γαμέω — marry; pres. inf. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic γαμεῖσθαι): of a woman, ’be married’
glossary.γενέσθαι: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. inf.: ’to have been born’

glossary.στυγερὸν: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σφέτερα: σφέτερος — their own; neut. acc. pl.: ’their own (homes)’
glossary.σῆμά: σῆμα — sign, mark, grave-mound; neut. acc. sg.

glossary.τελευτήσῃς: τελευτάω — finish, accomplish, bring to an end; aor. subj. 2 sg.

glossary.τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
glossary.τεύξουσι: τεύχω — make, make ready, prepare; fut. 3 pl.
glossary.τηλίκος: τηλίκος — of such an age, so old; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τιμῆεν: τιμήεις — precious, honoured; neut. nom./acc. sg., contracted τιμῆεν
glossary.τλαίης: τλῆναι (defective, root τλα-) — endure, bear, hold out; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you could endure’

glossary.τύμβον: τύμβος — burial mound, grave-mound; acc. sg.

glossary.φάρμακον: φάρμακον — drug, potion (healing or deadly); acc. sg.
glossary.φέρεσθαι: φέρω — carry; mid. pres. inf.: ’to carry off for oneself’
glossary.φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with φρονέω: ’with friendly thoughts, kindly’
glossary.φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.

glossary.φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; acc. sg.
glossary.φώς: φώς — man, hero (poetic word); nom. sg.
glossary.χαίρων: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’rejoicing’
glossary.χαλκήρεας: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze; masc. acc. pl.

glossary.χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable
glossary.χεῦαι: χέω — pour, heap up; aor. inf., used as imperative: ’heap up’ (of a grave-mound)

glossary.ἀναιδέσι: ἀναιδής — shameless (ἀν- + αἰδώς); masc. dat. pl.

glossary.ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv.
glossary.ἀνόπαια: ἀνόπαια — meaning disputed: ’upward’, or ’unseen’, or (divided ἀν’ ὀπαῖα) ’up through the smoke-vent’, or the name of a bird; adv., hapax legomenon
glossary.ἀνώγῃ: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with pres. sense); subj. 3 sg.: ’may bid’
glossary.ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
glossary.ἀποιχομένου: ἀποίχομαι — be gone away, be absent; pres. part. masc. gen. sg.: ’gone away’
glossary.ἀποτίσεται: ἀποτίνω — pay back, make pay, exact requital; fut. mid. 3 sg. ’will exact payment’, or perh. short-vowel aor. subj. (the form does not decide)
glossary.ἀποτμότατος: ἄποτμος — ill-fated, unlucky (ἀ- + πότμος); superl., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπώσεαι: ἀπωθέω — thrust away, drive out; 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted, either fut. ’you will thrust away’ or short-vowel aor. subj. (the form does not decide)
glossary.ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρνεῖται: ἀρνέομαι — refuse, deny, say no to; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀρτυνέουσιν: ἀρτύνω — arrange, prepare, make ready; fut. 3 pl., epic uncontracted
glossary.ἀσχαλόωσι: ἀσχαλάω — be vexed, chafe, be impatient; pres. 3 pl., epic diectasis (= Attic ἀσχαλῶσι)
glossary.ἀφνειὸς: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
glossary.ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ (ἐπεὶ ἂρ δή ’since, as it seems’)
glossary.ἄιστον: ἄιστος — unseen, vanished without trace (ἀ- + root of ἰδεῖν); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄιστος: ἄιστος — unseen, vanished without trace; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλκιμος: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, valiant, brave (from ἀλκή); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄνωγα: ἄνωγα — bid, command, order; perf. 1 sg. with pres. sense: ’I bid’
glossary.ἄνωχθι: ἄνωγα — bid, command; perf. imper. 2 sg.: ’bid! order!’
glossary.ἄξιον: ἄξιος — worth, worthy; neut. nom. sg., + gen.: ’worth (a return)’
glossary.ἄπυστος: ἄπυστος — unheard of, of whom nothing is learned (from root of πυνθάνομαι); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel
glossary.ἄρσας: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, equip, fit out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fitted out’
glossary.ἅρπυιαι: Ἅρπυιαι — the Harpies, snatching storm-winds personified as beings that carry people off without trace (from ἁρπάζω); nom. pl.
glossary.ἐβόλοντο: βόλομαι — wish, will (epic by-form of βούλομαι); impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’willed’
glossary.ἐγείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’bore’
glossary.ἐλθὲ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
glossary.ἐμεῦ: ἐγώ — I; gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’from me’
glossary.ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
glossary.ἐμπάζεο: ἐμπάζομαι — heed, care for, take account of; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐμπάζου), + gen.
glossary.ἐμός: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐμῶν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐνιαυτόν: ἐνιαυτός — year; acc. sg., accusative of duration: ’for a year’
glossary.ἐνόησα: νοέω — perceive, catch sight of, notice; aor. 1 sg., augmented
glossary.ἐπίμεινον: ἐπιμένω — wait, stay on, remain; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐπαλαστήσασα: ἐπαλαστέω — be indignant, be bitterly moved (rare verb, from ἄλαστος ’not to be forgotten’); aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπειγόμενός: ἐπείγω — press, urge on; mid./pass. ἐπείγομαι be in haste, press on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., + gen.: ’pressing on (for the road)’
glossary.ἐπιδήμιος: ἐπιδήμιος — at home, in one’s own land (from δῆμος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπικρατέουσιν: ἐπικρατέω — hold power over, rule; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -οῦσιν), + dat.
glossary.ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj.
glossary.ἐρέτῃσιν: ἐρέτης — rower, oarsman; dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἐρεείνεις: ἐρεείνω — ask, question (epic, from ἔρομαι); pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
glossary.ἐφείη: ἐφίημι — send against, lay (hands) on; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’would lay (his hands) on’
glossary.ἐφορμᾶται: ἐφορμάω — stir up, urge on; mid./pass. ἐφορμάομαι be roused, be set upon; pres. 3 sg.: ’is set upon, urges’
glossary.ἐφύρης: Ἐφύρη — Ephyra, name of several towns, not always identifiable; gen. sg.
glossary.ἐόντος: εἰμί — be; pres. part. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντος): ’being, alive’
glossary.ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
glossary.ἑλών: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’picking out, choosing’
glossary.ἑοῖς: ἑός — his own, her own (by-form of the possessive ὅς); masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἑτέρως: ἕτερος — other, otherwise; adv. ἑτέρως: ’otherwise, the other way’
glossary.ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔδοντες: ἔδω — eat (epic, = Attic ἐσθίω); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’eating’
glossary.ἔεδνα: ἔεδνα — wedding gifts, bridal gifts (prothetic ἐ-, beside ἕδνα); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’
glossary.ἔκτα: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., by-form ἔκτα (root aorist)
glossary.ἔλλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, win, get; aor. 3 sg., augmented with double λ, epic (= Attic ἔλαβε)
glossary.ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’
glossary.ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’
glossary.ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become, happen; aor. 3 sg. used with pres. force: ’is’
glossary.ἔρανος: ἔρανος — a meal to which each guest contributes his share (as against a feast given by a host); nom. sg.
glossary.ἔρξῃς: ἔρδω — do, work, accomplish (= ῥέζω); aor. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.ἔρχεο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου)
glossary.ἔσσ: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic ἔσσο, elided (ἔσσ’ = ἔσσο; = Attic ἴσθι): ’be!’
glossary.ἔστων: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 pl.: ’let them be’
glossary.ἔτ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided (ἔτ’ = ἔτι)
glossary.ἔτετμε: τέτμον (defective) — come upon, overtake; reduplicated aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’overtook’
glossary.ἔτευξαν: τεύχω — make, fashion, cause; aor. 3 pl., augmented
glossary.ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
glossary.ἕπεσθαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany, go with; pres. inf.: ’to go with, accompany’
glossary.ἠδέ: ἠδέ — and; epic conjunction, accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἡμετέρῳ: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’
glossary.ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
glossary.ἤρατ: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); mid. win, gain for oneself; aor. mid. 3 sg., augmented, elided (ἤρατ’ = ἤρατο): ’won’; in sense the aorist of ἄρνυμαι ’win’, under which some lexica file it
glossary.ἥρωας: ἥρως — hero, man of rank or noble birth; acc. pl.
glossary.ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε in ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’
glossary.ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
glossary.ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴλου: Ἶλος — Ilus, son of Mermerus, in Ephyra; gen. sg.
glossary.ἴτω: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let her go’
glossary.ὀίσατο: ὀίομαι — think, suppose, imagine; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ὀδυρόμενος: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
glossary.ὀδύνας: ὀδύνη — pain, grief, anguish; acc. pl.
glossary.ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind; in Homer also ’hereafter, in time to come’; adv.
glossary.ὀχέειν: ὀχέω — carry, keep up, uphold; pres. inf., epic uncontracted: ’to carry on, keep up (childish ways)’
glossary.ὀψιγόνων: ὀψίγονος — late-born, born in later generations; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ὁδοῖο: ὁδός — road, way, journey; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὁμιλήσειεν: ὁμιλέω — be in company with, meet, consort with; aor. opt. 3 sg., wish: ’might he come among’
glossary.ὁρόω: ὁράω — see; pres. 1 sg., epic stretched form (= Attic ὁρῶ)
glossary.ὁρόων: ὁράω — see; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic stretched (= Attic ὁρῶν): ’seeing’
glossary.ὄσσαν: ὄσσα — voice, rumour, report (personified, from Zeus); acc. sg.
glossary.ὄφελον: ὀφείλω — owe; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (Attic ὤφελον), with an infinitive, an unattainable wish: ’would that...’
glossary.ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
glossary.ὅμιλος: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng, gathering; nom. sg.
glossary.ὅππως: ὅπως — how, in what way; epic ὅππως (double π metri gratia), with κε + subj. (or fut.): ’how you are to…’
glossary.ὅσσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος (double σ), neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’as many as’
glossary.ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’ (correlative with τόσσοι)
glossary.ὑβρίζοντες: ὑβρίζω — act violently or insolently, commit outrage (from ὕβρις); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’behaving insolently’
glossary.ὑπέμνησέν: ὑπομιμνῄσκω — remind; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ὑπ-έ-μνησεν), + gen.: ’made mindful of’
glossary.ὑποθήσομαι: ὑποτίθημι — suggest, advise, put before; fut. mid. 1 sg.: ’I will advise’
glossary.ὠκύμοροί: ὠκύμορος — swift-doomed, early-doomed (ὠκύς + μόρος); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὧδ: ὧδε — so, thus, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
glossary.ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl.: ’in his own (mind)’ (φρεσὶν ᾗσι)
glossary.ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’
glossary.ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’
glossary.ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
